name: io.github.YoanWai/stremio-mcp
title: Stremio
description: MCP server for Stremio: search, browse, streams, library, and Android TV playback control.

environmentVariables.name: ANDROID_TV_HOST
environmentVariables.description: IP or hostname of the Android TV running Stremio. Required only for the TV playback/control tools; omit to use the addon and library tools alone.

environmentVariables.name: ANDROID_TV_PORT
environmentVariables.description: adb TCP port on the Android TV.
